title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how Primeweb Dynamics collects, uses and protects your information.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
content: Welcome to Primeweb Dynamics. We respect your privacy and are committed to handling your personal information responsibly.
This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you visit our website, submit an inquiry or register for a course.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
content: When you use our website forms, we may collect information such as your name, phone number, email address, selected course, branch and other details you choose to provide.
Some forms may also request additional information such as address, city, country, postal code, amount or message.
We may collect basic technical information related to website usage, such as browser and device information, where applicable.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
content: We may use the information you provide to respond to course inquiries and callback requests.
We may use your information to share course details, schedules, enrollment information and other relevant updates.
Information may also be used to manage registrations, provide support and improve our website and services.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing of Information
content: We do not intend to sell your personal information.
Information may be shared with authorized service providers when necessary to operate our website, manage inquiries or provide services.
Such service providers may include website hosting, communication, analytics and customer relationship management platforms, where used.

sections.heading: 5. Data Storage and Security
content: We take reasonable measures to protect the information submitted through our website.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Access to personal information should be limited to authorized persons who need it for legitimate business purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and Website Technologies
content: Our website or third-party services may use cookies or similar technologies to support website functionality and understand website usage.
You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect some website features.

sections.heading: 7. Third-Party Services and Links
content: Our website may use or link to third-party services and external websites.
These services may have their own privacy policies and data practices. We encourage you to review their policies before sharing personal information with them.

sections.heading: 8. Your Privacy Choices
content: You may contact us to ask about the personal information you have submitted through our website.
You may also request correction or deletion of your information, subject to applicable legal and business requirements.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
content: Our website is not specifically designed to collect personal information from children without appropriate authorization.
If you believe a child has submitted personal information without appropriate consent, please contact us so that the matter can be reviewed.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy when our website, services or data practices change.
Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised last-updated date.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
content: If you have questions, concerns or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal information, please contact Primeweb Dynamics using the details below.
